_comment: The managed AWS MCP Server (GA) replaces the five retired awslabs local servers (cdk, documentation, dynamodb, ecs, pricing). AWS folds documentation/knowledge tools into the managed server and recommends removing the old standalone entries, including the former AWS Knowledge server. Auth: the MCP Proxy for AWS (pinned) signs requests with the user's IAM credentials (SigV4) and forwards to the regional managed endpoint; clients that support the server's OAuth flow may instead register the endpoint directly as an http server. Scoping agent access is IAM's job: use the aws:ViaAWSMCPService / aws:CalledViaAWSMCP condition keys. Region: endpoint and metadata use us-west-2, matching this pack's previous default.
